thanks: Thank you for your feedback and reports. They make every release better.
fixes: Messages from Portal AI Host now say clearly why it can't answer right now (paused, quiet hours, a game running, or the home PC unreachable).
The app icon now shows on every window and in the taskbar preview at every display scale.

cards.title: Update notice
cards.body: The app now tells you when a newer version is in the Microsoft Store, with an Update button.
